decisions.reason: The DPA management tool fits the firm's agency focus and has a page of its own plus positive customer feedback, so results appear to meet aspirations and the low maintenance cost gives no trigger for problemistic search.
The hosting management platform is featured on the home page in both years, which signals a core offering performing at or above aspiration that management would not abandon.
The configurable managed hosting plan extends the established hosting business with a dedicated page in both years and carries little separate cost, so there is no shortfall prompting a drop.

Extended PHP security support is only mentioned and its results are still uncertain, but it is cheap to carry within existing slack and protects customers on legacy PHP versions; being tied to deprecation cycles, it may be reworked or folded in later rather than dropped now.
